name: Ama Ero ~Doutei-kun o Yasashiku Escort~
original_name: あまエロ ～童貞君を優しくエスコート～
source:
The protagonist wanted to become an adult soon in order to have sex with women. But he is now a university student and still a virgin. Because the women he had his eyes on were all older than him, they thought that he was childish, immature and such.

But those days are over. He is going to improve himself and becomes a better adult. Suddenly, 4 women shows interested in him. Is this a reward for his hard work? And so begins his adult sex life.

[Translated from [url=http://www.interheart.co.jp/index.php?cID=601]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主人公为了尽快成为大人、和女性发生关系，曾经非常努力。然而如今他已经是大学生，却仍然是处男。因为他看上的女性都比自己年长，她们认为他幼稚、不成熟。

但那些日子已经结束。他要提升自己，成为更好的成年人。突然，有4名女性对他产生兴趣。这是努力得到的奖励吗？他的成年性爱生活就此开始。
